annotation.title_clean: ISO/TR 20545:2017 Intelligent transport systems — Vehicle/roadway warning and control systems — Report on standardisation for vehicle automated driving systems (RoVAS)/Beyond driver assistance systems
annotation.title_en: ISO/TR 20545:2017 Intelligent transport systems — Vehicle/roadway warning and control systems — Report on standardisation for vehicle automated driving systems (RoVAS)/Beyond driver assistance systems
annotation.summary_en: ISO catalogue page for ISO/TR 20545:2017, a technical report from ISO/TC 204 identifying potential standardization areas for automated driving systems that control longitudinal and lateral vehicle motion simultaneously. It maps areas without assigning who standardizes or when.
key_provisions_or_claims: Technical report on potential standardization areas for automated driving systems
Defines automated driving systems as controlling longitudinal and lateral motion simultaneously
Systematically extracts and organizes standardization items
Timing and responsibility for standardization are discussed separately
